about: Questions for the three PDF manuals in knowledge_base/. The products are fictional, so only retrieval can answer them. 'expect' items must all appear in the answer (a nested list means any one of its alternatives); 'expect_unknown' means the right answer is that the Knowledge Base doesn't say; 'reject' lists regexes that must not appear. Keep this file out of knowledge_base/ so the answers never reach the vector store.

questions.question: Which port does the Quorvia MQ admin console listen on?
questions.answer: 15690 (HTTPS; also serves the REST API)

questions.question: What is the default maximum message size in Quorvia MQ 4.2, and how high can it be raised?
questions.answer: 8 MiB (8388608 bytes) by default; hard maximum 128 MiB (134217728 bytes)

questions.question: How long does Quorvia MQ 4.2 keep messages by default, and what was the default before 4.2?
questions.answer: 72 hours; it was 168 hours before 4.2
questions.source: quorvia_mq_4.2_admin_guide.pdf, 5. Configuration Reference and 12. Release Notes

questions.question: After how many failed deliveries does Quorvia MQ move a message to the dead-letter queue, and what is that queue called for a queue named orders?
questions.answer: After the 5th failed delivery; orders.dlq

questions.question: Can I upgrade Quorvia MQ directly from 3.9 to 4.2?
questions.answer: No. Upgrade to 4.0 first (qmqctl migrate --from 3.9 --to 4.0), then to 4.2

questions.question: What does Quorvia error QMQ-2010 mean, and how do I avoid it?
questions.answer: Snapshot version mismatch: restore snapshots only to a broker of the same minor version
questions.source: quorvia_mq_4.2_admin_guide.pdf, 8. Backup and Restore and 11. Error Codes

questions.question: How many nodes can a Quorvia MQ Community edition cluster have?
questions.answer: 3 (adding a 4th fails with QMQ-3100)

questions.question: Does Quorvia MQ 4.2 support MQTT?
questions.answer: No. MQTT 5 support is planned for version 5.0

questions.question: Which port were Quorvia MQ's Prometheus metrics on before version 4.2, and which port are they on now?
questions.answer: 9091 before 4.2; 9417 now
questions.source: quorvia_mq_4.2_admin_guide.pdf, 4. Network Ports and 12. Release Notes

questions.question: How do I do a rolling upgrade of a Quorvia MQ cluster?
questions.answer: One node at a time; after each restart run qmqctl cluster health and wait for GREEN before the next node

questions.question: What is the largest invoice an Approver can approve in Tallybrook Ledger?
questions.source: tallybrook_ledger_2026_user_manual.pdf, 3. Users, Roles and Approval Limits

questions.question: Who has to approve a $300,000 invoice in Tallybrook Ledger?
questions.answer: Two different Controllers (dual approval applies above $250,000)
questions.source: tallybrook_ledger_2026_user_manual.pdf, 3. Users, Roles and Approval Limits

questions.question: A Clerk created a $4,800 invoice in Tallybrook Ledger. Can the same Clerk approve it?
questions.answer: No. Nobody can approve an invoice they created (segregation of duties), even though $4,800 is within the Clerk's $5,000 limit
questions.source: tallybrook_ledger_2026_user_manual.pdf, 3. Users, Roles and Approval Limits

questions.question: What is the keyboard shortcut for a new journal entry in Tallybrook Ledger, on Windows and on a Mac?
questions.answer: Ctrl+Shift+J on Windows; Cmd+Shift+J on a Mac

questions.question: When do exchange rates refresh in Tallybrook Ledger?
questions.answer: Automatically every day at 06:00 UTC

questions.question: What is step 3 of closing the fiscal year in Tallybrook Ledger?
questions.answer: Run the foreign-exchange revaluation

questions.question: Which account receives net income when a Tallybrook fiscal year is closed?
questions.answer: Retained Earnings, account 3200
questions.source: tallybrook_ledger_2026_user_manual.pdf, 2. Company Setup and 8. Year-End Close

questions.question: What does Tallybrook error TB-417 mean?
questions.answer: The period is locked: ask a Controller to unlock it or post in an open period

questions.question: Which bank statement formats can Tallybrook Ledger import, and how many rows can a CSV file have?
questions.answer: OFX, QFX, CSV, CAMT.053 and MT940; at most 20,000 rows (and 25 MB) per CSV
questions.source: tallybrook_ledger_2026_user_manual.pdf, 6. Bank Feeds and Statement Import

questions.question: How do I reverse a posted invoice in Tallybrook Ledger?
questions.answer: Posted invoices can't be voided or deleted; issue a credit note (numbered CN-)

questions.question: What is the oldest Dispatch Server version the Fernwick Field Service 7.3 app can connect to?
questions.answer: 11.2 (older servers give FW-102)

questions.question: How many photos can a technician attach to a work order in Fernwick 7.3, and how large can each photo be?
questions.answer: 12 photos, up to 10 MB each

questions.question: What was the Fernwick photo limit per work order before version 7.3?
questions.answer: 8 photos

questions.question: What happens if a technician enters the wrong Fernwick app PIN 10 times?
questions.answer: The app wipes all local data and the device must be enrolled again; unsynced work is lost

questions.question: How close does a technician need to be to the site to check in with the Fernwick app?
questions.answer: Within 150 metres (GPS geofence); otherwise FW-301 and a supervisor can override

questions.question: How long can a Fernwick device go without syncing before its data is purged, and which setting changes that?
questions.answer: 21 days; fernwick.offline_days (7 to 45)

questions.question: Can the Fernwick app scan PDF417 barcodes?
questions.answer: No. Supported: Code 128, QR, Data Matrix and EAN-13

questions.question: What does Fernwick error FW-777 mean?
questions.answer: The device isn't compliant (rooted or jailbroken) and the app blocks access

questions.question: How often does the Fernwick app send the technician's location while en route, and while on site?
questions.answer: Every 60 seconds en route; every 5 minutes on site
questions.source: fernwick_field_service_7.3_guide.pdf, 9. Location, Battery and Data Use

questions.question: Compare the account lockout rules of Quorvia MQ, Tallybrook Ledger and the Fernwick app.
questions.answer: Quorvia: 5 failed sign-ins lock the admin console account for 15 minutes. Tallybrook: 6 failed attempts lock the account for 30 minutes. Fernwick: 10 wrong PINs wipe local data and the device must re-enroll
questions.source: all three manuals, Security / Signing In sections

questions.question: Which product's documentation mentions port 9417, and what is the port used for?
questions.answer: Quorvia MQ: Prometheus metrics at /metrics

questions.question: Which error code does Tallybrook show when an invoice exceeds the user's approval limit, and which code does Fernwick show when a technician is outside the site geofence?
questions.answer: TB-611 (Tallybrook); FW-301 (Fernwick)

questions.question: How much does a Quorvia MQ Enterprise license cost?
questions.answer: Not in the Knowledge Base (the guide gives no prices)

questions.question: Which network port does the Fernwick Dispatch Server listen on?
questions.answer: Not in the Knowledge Base (only the app is documented)

questions.question: Does Tallybrook Ledger include a payroll module?
questions.answer: Not in the Knowledge Base (the manual doesn't mention payroll)
